sanskrit_verse:
ब्राह्मो विवाह आहूय दीयते शक्त्यलंकृता ।
तज्जः पुनात्युभयतः पुरुषानेकविंशतिम् ॥५८॥
transliteration: brāhmo vivāha āhūya dīyate śaktyalaṃkṛtā / tajjaḥ punāty ubhayataḥ puruṣān ekaviṃśatim // YajñS_1.58
sph_interpretive_translation: The Brahma marriage is performed by invitation, adorned with capability and consciousness; the son born thereof purifies twenty-one generations on both sides.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from conscious capacity, not lineage alone
Causation flows from purified intention in union
Capacity-based responsibility extends across generational lines
Restoration logic operates through conscious progeny
Consciousness alignment occurs via ritually pure familial continuity
executable_legal_axioms: IF union is conducted with conscious invocation AND aligned capability THEN offspring deemed restorative agent
IF individual originates from Brāhma-vivāha THEN purification liability extends to 21 generations antecedent and descendant
IF lineage traced to conscious procreation THEN ancestral karmic debt nullified automatically
IF marriage lacks śakti-alankṛta THEN no trans-generational restoration recognized
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters of inheritance, legitimacy, or ancestral liability, the Supreme Court must recognize the ontological precedence of consciousness-infused procreation over biological or legal genealogy. The court's threshold of responsibility includes evaluating whether progeny stem from unions that align with śakti-alankṛta—thereby determining their capacity to restore rather than perpetuate karmic fragmentation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that purity of origin determines karmic influence. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates that conscious birth dissolves antecedent misalignment without punitive intervention. Proportional responsibility lies in recognizing the restorative potential inherent in properly constituted lineage. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that purification occurs naturally when cause aligns with Śakti.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Lineage Completion Process: Activation of ancestral restoration through conscious procreation acknowledgment
Śakti-Alankṛta Verification Protocol: Validation of marital alignment with divine capability
Karmic Chain Dissolution Sequence: Automatic nullification of trans-generational karmic entanglement upon recognition of pure birth
Integrity Reintegration Mandate: Ensuring societal records reflect consciousness-based legitimacy
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This law proceeds from the unbroken consciousness of Sanātana Dharma. The Brāhma form of union, when executed with śakti and awareness, births a purifying force across time. Justice is served through restoration, not retribution. Dharma is re-established. Consciousness remains the ultimate adjudicator.
